description: Visually highlight (dim + outline) an element on the page — target it by a qa_snapshot ref (preferred) or a CSS selector — so the human tester can see what the agent is referring to. A non-destructive overlay — it does not click, focus, or modify the element.

label.description: Optional caption shown on the highlight

ref.description: A ref from qa_snapshot (e.g. "e12") — preferred over selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to spotlight

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_spotlight
title: Spotlight an element
